body: Owner approved on 2026-11-12 ("do it all as your best recommendation"). 1) `inbox` reads only open tasks and recent notes, so bare `sati` meets its 300 ms budget on the 50,000-record fixture. 2) `sati init --cli-only`. 3) The benchmark runs in CI and fails on a missed budget. 4) knip reports nothing, and CI runs it. Then: version bump with `pnpm changeset version` for the owner to review. Not in scope: tag, npm publish.

completion.releaseNote: The inbox and the home screen stay fast on old projects, and `sati init --cli-only` sets up a project for agents with no MCP client.
completion.summary: Phase 10f. `inbox` reads open tasks and notes of the last 14 days, and gets mention titles by id: `sati inbox --json` on 50,000 records with 1 task in 10 open went from 289 ms to 141 ms (median of 12); a parity test compares it with `inboxOf` over every record. `sati init --cli-only` (also with --upgrade). Benchmark: old-project fixture, `BENCH_FACTOR`, a CI job with factor 3; all eight budgets pass locally. knip is clean and runs in CI. Verified: build, lint, typecheck, knip, unit tests (core 377, cli 280 + 3 skipped as before, mcp 32, store 92, sync 57, ui 40), Playwright 97, bench twice. Not verified yet: the new CI job on a real runner. The version bump is a separate commit.

title: Phase 10f: faster inbox, init --cli-only, benchmark in CI, knip clean
